snippet.title: SHALTER-03 – Official Gameplay Trailer | Co-op Puzzle Adventure
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist SHALTER-03 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4098070/SHALTER03/

Time is ticking. Three characters stripped of sight, hearing and speech — and the only way out is together.

SHALTER-03 is a first-person co-op puzzle adventure where every level brings its own mechanics and its own rules. Communicate, adapt fast, balance buffs and nerfs, and find the most efficient path before the clock runs out. Adaptability is your greatest weapon.

🧩 Different Puzzles, Different Rules: What solved the last puzzle may not work on the next. Every level makes you rethink your approach.
⚡ Buffs & Nerfs: Temporary effects change how puzzles and the environment behave. The right effect at the right moment can turn everything around.
👁️ First-Person Perspective: Perspective, distance and timing are part of every solution.
⏳ Race Against Time: Every level has a time limit. Mistakes cost seconds; mastery earns better results.
🤝 Built for Co-op: Play online, over LAN or cross-platform with your team.
